cause.en: The model named in the request does not exist on this Ollama server.
cause.id: Model yang disebut di request tidak ada di server Ollama ini.

user_fix.en: Check the model name with `ollama list` and pull it first with `ollama pull <model>`.
user_fix.id: Cek nama model dengan `ollama list` dan unduh dulu dengan `ollama pull <model>`.

operator_fix.en: Pre-pull the models your app needs when provisioning the server.
operator_fix.id: Unduh dulu model yang dibutuhkan aplikasi saat menyiapkan server.

title.en: 502 Bad Gateway (cloud model cannot be reached)

cause.en: Ollama could not reach a cloud model.
cause.id: Ollama tidak bisa menjangkau model cloud.

user_fix.en: Check the internet connection of the machine running Ollama, then retry.
user_fix.id: Cek koneksi internet mesin yang menjalankan Ollama, lalu ulangi.

operator_fix.en: Check outbound network and sign-in for cloud models on the Ollama host.
operator_fix.id: Cek jaringan keluar dan login model cloud di host Ollama.

message: an error was encountered while running the model
the model failed to generate a response

title.en: the model failed to generate a response / error while running the model

cause.en: The model failed while generating. If it happens mid-stream, the error arrives as an NDJSON line with an `error` field and the HTTP status stays 200.
cause.id: Model gagal saat menghasilkan jawaban. Kalau terjadi di tengah streaming, error datang sebagai baris NDJSON dengan field `error` dan status HTTP tetap 200.

user_fix.en: Check each streamed line for an `error` field, then look at the Ollama server log before retrying.
user_fix.id: Cek setiap baris stream apakah ada field `error`, lalu lihat log server Ollama sebelum mengulang.

operator_fix.en: Read the Ollama server log to find the cause before retrying the same request.
operator_fix.id: Baca log server Ollama untuk mencari penyebabnya sebelum mengulang request yang sama.
